initialization: Same-seed sealed F10 rehearsal final, reset Adam. BC trains actor/shared trunk only with the sealed NLL/Adam kernel, preserving value-head weights but not promising unchanged values. RL resets Adam for both control F10 and imitation endpoint. No architecture or observation changes.
teacher: Frozen tactical-v1 plays both sides of 512 fresh official train games and 128 separate development probe games, at most120 turns. Every attempted decision/frame and unavailable feedback is retained; accepted actions only form supervised rows. No win/loss filtering. Each teacher is limited to its own projected protocol/request. Labels are demonstrations, not optimal action truth.
sampling: Every BC batch samples64 train games uniformly with replacement, then one accepted decision per selected game; add64 uniformly sampled sealed F7 train rows. IDs/fingerprints/metrics stored each step. No development probe rows or outcomes enter BC or RL. Rehearsal during both RL arms uses the unchanged128-row F7 batch at .1.
rl: Matched32 cohorts of1024 selected rows; complete official train battles against tactical, alternating learner side, eight-game chunks until quota, cap128 games/cohort. Complete GAE before uniform sampling without replacement; sealed PPO two epochs x four256-row minibatches. Same sampling namespaces for both arms; on-policy cursors/games can diverge.
evaluation: Four frozen endpoints per seed, all64 fresh development team/mechanics pairs in both seats against three frozen opponents. Same coordinates/actor keys per endpoint. 128 separate development teacher games diagnose imitation agreement. All512 known F10 tactical probes at each endpoint assess retention.
gate: Retain45 contrasts: imitation/initial, control_rl/initial, imitation_rl/initial, imitation_rl/control_rl, imitation_rl/imitation for3 opponents x3 seeds. Per-seed imitation benefit requires tactical >=5pp and adjusted-bootstrap lower>0 versus initial, no detected other-opponent regression, <=5% cutoff each cell, all32 tactical contexts retained. Pipeline benefit requires those same criteria versus initial AND control_rl. Incremental RL benefit requires those criteria versus imitation. Overall gates require all3 seeds. Teacher-agreement NLL/accuracy are descriptive, not strength gates.
interpretation: Exploratory local full-battle development screen after F14. Fresh generated coordinates in existing R7 train/development partitions; current training/development whole-team hashes must be disjoint and teacher-probe/evaluation hashes must be disjoint. Species/mechanics recur; no public-ladder or final-heldout generalization claim. Small64-pair adjusted percentile bootstrap has approximate coverage; retain Hoeffding bounds and cutoffs as unresolved intervals. No seed/endpoint selection, restarts or budget extensions. F10 remains reference pending broader evidence.
verification: Freeze source/runtime/plan, run one campaign then exhaustive fresh replay: teacher frames/actions/datasets, all BC/RL updates/batches/metrics, all evaluation games/policy values, probe probabilities, initial/final checkpoints and9 original-next-update recoveries.
